department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmer families owning cultivable land

eligibility_criteria.land_ownership: Must own cultivable landholding in their name as per official state land records
eligibility_criteria.family_definition: Farmer family consists of husband, wife, and minor children
eligibility_criteria.income_limit: No explicit cap, but excluded if paying income tax
exclusions: Farmer families in which one or more of its members hold or held constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers/State Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, Chairpersons of District Panchayats
Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments and field units (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000/- or more (excluding Group D / MTS)
All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out practice

benefits.financial_assistance: Rs. 6,000 per year provided to eligible farmer families
benefits.payment_mode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each
benefits.disbursement_schedule: Period 1: April-July; Period 2: August-November; Period 3: December-March

online_steps: Visit official portal https://pmkisan.gov.in/ and navigate to 'Farmers Corner'
Select 'New Farmer Registration' and choose Rural or Urban Farmer Registration
Enter Aadhaar Number, active Mobile Number, and select State
Authenticate using Aadhaar OTP received on registered mobile number
Fill landholding details (survey number, khasra/khatian number, area in hectares)
Upload land ownership documents and submit application
Complete mandatory e-KYC (biometric via CSC or OTP-based on portal)
application_process.offline_option: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), local Village Patwari, Revenue Officer, or Nodal Officer (PM-KISAN) nominated by State Government

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant farmer
Land ownership document / Record of Rights (RoR) / Khatoni / Patta
Aadhaar-seeded active Bank Account Passbook with IFSC code
Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
